extracted.intended_audience: prospective postdoctoral applicants for the Branco Weiss Fellowship
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and selection-relevant criteria for applicants to the Branco Weiss Fellowship: early-career postdocs in sciences and engineering proposing projects and engaging with society. Emphasizes excellence, vision, and societal engagement, and allows hosting at any suitable academic institution worldwide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible career stage and fields
rubrics_metrics.description: The fellowship is designed for postdocs in all areas of sciences and engineering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be at the postdoctoral stage; disciplines across the sciences and engineering are eligible (i.e., broad disciplinary scope within sciences/engineering).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research excellence / rising_star potential
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates are 'rising stars in their respective fields'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied expectation of high research promise and distinction within the candidate's field (the page frames fellows as exceptional postdocs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Vision for reshaping the field
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates must have a vision for realizing their own dreams of reshaping the future of their fields of science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should propose work that is not only scientifically strong but aims to change or advance their field — a forward-looking, ambitious project or intellectual agenda.

rubrics_metrics.name: Willingness to engage with society
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates must be willing to engage in a dialogue with society on relevant social, cultural, political or economic issues across the frontiers of their particular discipline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection favors applicants who plan to communicate with or involve broader societal conversations (public engagement, interdisciplinary societal relevance, policy/cultural/economic implications).

rubrics_metrics.name: Host institution / project fit
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates can apply for a project to be hosted by any academic institution worldwide, provided that it is exceedingly well suited for the task.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While hosting location is flexible, the proposed host and environment must be an excellent fit for the project's needs — strong alignment between project goals and host capacity is required.
